NIBRS Element 1. This is the unique nine-character NCIC Originating Agency Identifier (ORI) Number that has been assigned to each agency
NIBRS Element 2. This is the number assigned by the reporting agency to each Incident Report to uniquely identify an incident, e.g., the Originating Agency Case (OCA) Number.

NIBRS Element 3. This data element must be included in each Incident Report. It should be used to enter the month, day, and year (YYYY-MM-DD) the incident occurred or started or the beginning of the time period in which it occurred (as appropriate) when the time is not known.

NIBRS Element 2A. This data element indicates whether or not the incident involved a Cargo Theft. Although it is an optional data element, once added to a submission, it becomes conditional and must be populated with a valid data value.
